Long ago, in antediluvian times, Hannibal, the Archenemy of Rome, led an army of demonic creatures and damned souls against the Eternal City, hoping to destroy it. During the great war, Hannibal, however, was defeated and thrown into the depths of the underworld. And although Hannibal cannot get out of the depths of Hell, the whispers of the Archenemy seduces the impious souls, and insane cultists abduct and burn alive innocent children on the shrines of Hanu-Baal.
